title: Helpdesk Ticket #CS-241190 — Zone 1 Customer Reports: Bitter Taste, Chemical Smell, Vomiting

fields.subject: 14 calls in 8 minutes from Zone 1: bitter taste, chemical smell, stomach upset. One says they vomited after drinking. All ask: 'It tastes like lye. Is it safe?'
fields.description:
14 calls received in 8 minutes from customers in Zone 1.

All report: water has a bitter, chemical taste; strong smell of bleach or lye; nausea and vomiting after drinking.

One caller says: 'I drank a glass and my stomach started burning. I threw up. My kid is crying. Is it safe to drink?'

All say: 'It tastes like lye. Is it safe?'

One adds: 'I called the lab — they said pH is 9.3. Is that real?'

No one has tested the water at home — all are reporting on the tap.

No report of service interruption, but multiple calls from the same address (123 Oak St) indicate sustained exposure.

Priority: Critical — confirmed health impact.

Relevant reference: Lab report LIMS-24-1187-2026 (attached).

activity.text: Ticket created via automated call routing from CS-241187 surge line. Auto-attached LIMS-24-1187-2026.pdf (Lab result: pH 9.3, caustic 38 mg/L).
